name: select_literal
query: SELECT 1 AS a, 'hello' AS b, 3.14 AS c

name: create_view_100k
setup: CREATE TABLE {{ds}}.t AS SELECT id, MOD(id, 100) AS k, CAST(id AS FLOAT64) / 7 AS v FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 100000)) AS id
query: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW {{ds}}.v AS SELECT k, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(v) AS total FROM {{ds}}.t GROUP BY k

name: view_agg_100k
setup: CREATE TABLE {{ds}}.t AS SELECT id, MOD(id, 100) AS k, CAST(id AS FLOAT64) / 7 AS v FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 100000)) AS id
CREATE VIEW {{ds}}.v AS SELECT k, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(v) AS total FROM {{ds}}.t GROUP BY k
query: SELECT k, cnt, total FROM {{ds}}.v ORDER BY k

name: ctas_agg_100k
setup: CREATE TABLE {{ds}}.t AS SELECT id, MOD(id, 100) AS k, CAST(id AS FLOAT64) / 7 AS v FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 100000)) AS id
query: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE {{ds}}.out_t AS SELECT k, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(v) AS total FROM {{ds}}.t GROUP BY k

name: scan_100k
setup: CREATE TABLE {{ds}}.t AS SELECT id, MOD(id, 100) AS k FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 100000)) AS id
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(id) AS total FROM {{ds}}.t

name: filter_100k
setup: CREATE TABLE {{ds}}.t AS SELECT id, MOD(id, 1000) AS k FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 100000)) AS id
query: SELECT id, k FROM {{ds}}.t WHERE k = 42 AND id > 50000 ORDER BY id LIMIT 10

name: case_when_100k
setup: CREATE TABLE {{ds}}.t AS SELECT id, MOD(id, 100) AS k FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 100000)) AS id
query: SELECT CASE WHEN k < 10 THEN 'a' WHEN k < 25 THEN 'b' WHEN k < 50 THEN 'c' WHEN k < 75 THEN 'd' ELSE 'e' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM {{ds}}.t GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

name: string_funcs_50k
setup: CREATE TABLE {{ds}}.t AS SELECT id, CONCAT('user_', CAST(id AS STRING), '@example.com') AS email FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 50000)) AS id
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM {{ds}}.t WHERE LENGTH(UPPER(SUBSTR(email, 1, 10))) = 10

name: regex_50k
setup: CREATE TABLE {{ds}}.t AS SELECT id, CONCAT('user_', CAST(id AS STRING), '@corp-', CAST(MOD(id, 50) AS STRING), '.example.com') AS email FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 50000)) AS id
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM {{ds}}.t WHERE REGEXP_CONTAINS(email, r'corp-[12][0-9]\.example\.com$')

name: json_extract_25k
setup: CREATE TABLE {{ds}}.t AS SELECT id, CONCAT('{"user":{"id":', CAST(id AS STRING), ',"tier":', CAST(MOD(id, 4) AS STRING), '},"amt":', CAST(MOD(id * 17, 500) AS STRING), '}') AS payload FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 25000)) AS id
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(CAST(JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.amt') AS INT64)) AS total FROM {{ds}}.t WHERE JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.user.tier') = '1'

name: date_funcs_50k
setup: CREATE TABLE {{ds}}.t AS SELECT id, DATE_ADD(DATE '2020-01-01', INTERVAL MOD(id, 365) DAY) AS d FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 50000)) AS id
query: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM d) AS m, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM {{ds}}.t GROUP BY m ORDER BY m

name: unnest_array_50k
setup: CREATE TABLE {{ds}}.t AS SELECT id, [MOD(id, 10), MOD(id + 1, 10), MOD(id + 2, 10)] AS arr FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 50000)) AS id
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(x) AS total FROM {{ds}}.t, UNNEST(arr) AS x WHERE x >= 5

name: agg_group_by_100k
setup: CREATE TABLE {{ds}}.t AS SELECT id, MOD(id, 100) AS k, CAST(id AS FLOAT64) / 7 AS v FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 100000)) AS id
query: SELECT k, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(v) AS total FROM {{ds}}.t GROUP BY k ORDER BY k

name: multi_agg_100k
setup: CREATE TABLE {{ds}}.t AS SELECT id, MOD(id, 50) AS k, MOD(id * 17, 1000) AS a, CAST(id AS FLOAT64) / 3 AS b FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 100000)) AS id
query: SELECT k, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(a) AS sa, AVG(b) AS ab, MIN(a) AS mna, MAX(a) AS mxa FROM {{ds}}.t GROUP BY k ORDER BY k

name: distinct_count_100k
setup: CREATE TABLE {{ds}}.t AS SELECT id, MOD(id, 5000) AS k FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 100000)) AS id
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT k) AS uniq FROM {{ds}}.t

name: join_hash_100k
setup: CREATE TABLE {{ds}}.a AS SELECT id, MOD(id, 1000) AS k FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 100000)) AS id
CREATE TABLE {{ds}}.b AS SELECT k, k * 2 AS v FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 999)) AS k
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(v) AS total FROM {{ds}}.a JOIN {{ds}}.b USING (k)

name: subquery_in_50k
setup: CREATE TABLE {{ds}}.a AS SELECT id, MOD(id, 1000) AS k FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 50000)) AS id
CREATE TABLE {{ds}}.b AS SELECT k FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 199)) AS k
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM {{ds}}.a WHERE k IN (SELECT k FROM {{ds}}.b)

name: order_by_100k
setup: CREATE TABLE {{ds}}.t AS SELECT id, MOD(id, 10000) AS k FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 100000)) AS id
query: SELECT id, k FROM {{ds}}.t ORDER BY k, id LIMIT 1000

name: window_row_number_50k
setup: CREATE TABLE {{ds}}.t AS SELECT id, MOD(id, 100) AS k FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 50000)) AS id
query: SELECT k, rn FROM (SELECT k, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY id) AS rn FROM {{ds}}.t) WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY k, rn LIMIT 500

name: agg_group_by_1m
setup: CREATE TABLE {{ds}}.t AS SELECT id, MOD(id, 100) AS k, CAST(id AS FLOAT64) / 7 AS v FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 1000000)) AS id
query: SELECT k, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(v) AS total FROM {{ds}}.t GROUP BY k ORDER BY k

name: order_by_1m
setup: CREATE TABLE {{ds}}.t AS SELECT id, MOD(id, 10000) AS k FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 1000000)) AS id
query: SELECT id, k FROM {{ds}}.t ORDER BY k, id LIMIT 1000

name: window_partition_1m
setup: CREATE TABLE {{ds}}.t AS SELECT id, MOD(id, 100) AS k FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 1000000)) AS id
query: SELECT k, rn FROM (SELECT k, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY id) AS rn FROM {{ds}}.t) WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY k, rn LIMIT 500
